🎧 Table DJ
Local preview: what you upload or link plays in your own browser only. Everyone hearing the same track at the same table needs the shared multiplayer server — that's on the build-week roadmap, not this preview.
Spotify links play 30-second previews unless you are signed in to Spotify in this browser, and their volume is set in the Spotify player. Your own uploaded files play in full and follow the volume slider under the DJ button.
